summary: Enhance your financial decision-making skills with our Business Analytics training course. Learn to leverage data for strategic insights and improved outcomes.
lede: Business analytics for financial decision-making training helps finance professionals turn financial data, business intelligence, and structured analysis into defensible choices. It develops practical skills in budgeting, variance analysis, forecasting, scenario modeling, KPI interpretation, and investment appraisal so teams can explain trade-offs with greater clarity. You will build forecast assumptions, test sensitivities, organize data in Excel, create finance dashboards in Power BI, and structure decisions using cost-benefit analysis, net present value, return on investment, and payback logic. The course also introduces SQL concepts and AI-assisted analysis workflows, with hands-on templates and calculations designed for real-world budget pressure, data limitations, and competing priorities.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who need to turn financial data into decisions, forecasts, and board-ready analysis.
prerequisites: Preferred prerequisites include basic comfort with spreadsheets, familiarity with finance terminology such as revenue, cost, margin, and variance, and an interest in using data for decision support. No coding background is required, although prior exposure to Excel formulas, pivot tables, or finance reporting will help you move faster. Participants should bring a laptop with spreadsheet software available and be prepared to work with sample financial datasets, dashboard templates, and scenario exercises during the course. Advanced analytics is covered at an operational application level, not as technical programming or model-building depth.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
